## Profile

MSc Bioinformatics student at the University of Bologna with a background in Medical Laboratory Sciences and a primary focus on protein sequence modelling, protein language models, and ML-based functional annotation. Experienced with ESM-2 embeddings, signal peptide prediction, HMMER/MMseqs2 workflows, DNA methylation analysis in R/Bioconductor, and reproducible ML pipelines. Broader interests include AI applications in proteomics, transcriptomics, single-cell omics, and biomedical data science.

## Publication

**Mechanism-based targeting of lactate dehydrogenase tetramerization by naturally derived compounds: A survey of molecular docking, molecular dynamics, and QSAR analysis**
*Computers in Biology and Medicine, 2025*

Investigated plant-derived compounds as LDH inhibitors for anticancer applications; identified 5 top candidates from pomegranate and sumac with docking scores >8 kcal/mol and stable MD simulations over 100 ns.

[View article](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compbiomed.2025.111000)
